title: 0136 at a glance: an app from a description or from code

cards.title: An AI builds an app over MCP
cards.text: It picks one of two ways, and the tool says which.

cards.title: A description
cards.text: Data the framework checks, refuses with a reason, and builds only from parts tested by hand. The safe way.

cards.title: Code on the packages
cards.text: For what no description says yet. Not checked by the framework, so a person reviews it.

cards.title: A person confirms
cards.text: Nothing goes live, either way, until a person says yes.
